approved_payload.content: Police say a family meeting to resolve domestic issues in Lillydale Trust ended in a shooting at about 16:00 on Thursday 8 October. A man allegedly took a licensed firearm from his vehicle and shot two women, Marvel Khosa and her daughter Ayanda Khosa, who were rushed to a nearby medical facility and declared dead there (police spokesperson Colonel Mavela Masondo, via Lowvelder). This pin counts those two killings. Note: the gunman then allegedly turned the gun on himself and was found dead at the scene; his death is recorded here as a note, not counted as a killing. Calcutta police opened two murder dockets and an inquest docket. The victims are named as reported, by the owner's decision of 23 October; the gunman is not named here. One report, resting on police: Lowvelder, 10 October. The pin is approximate (village level).
